patterns.message: packages/core is pure and deterministic: node:* modules are forbidden here so the same code runs in daemon, tests and the browser (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §packages/core, ADR 0004).
packages/core is pure and imports nothing from the workspace: it must stay free of I/O and side effects (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §packages/core, ADR 0004).

deniedGlobals.window: packages/core is pure and runs in daemon, tests and the browser: it must not reference browser globals like window (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §packages/core).
deniedGlobals.document: packages/core is pure and runs in daemon, tests and the browser: it must not reference browser globals like document (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §packages/core).

entries.message: packages/core is pure and deterministic: time comes from event timestamps or an injected Clock, never Date.now() (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §packages/core, ADR 0004).
packages/core is pure and deterministic: randomness comes from an injected seeded RNG, never Math.random() (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §packages/core, ADR 0004).
